description: Compare two user snapshot files, calculate user differences (deleted, added, modified), and export the diff report to an Excel or CSV spreadsheet.
command:
python3 -c '
import sys, os, json, csv

s1 = sys.argv[1].strip() if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""
s2 = sys.argv[2].strip() if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ""
out = sys.argv[3].strip() if len(sys.argv) > 3 and sys.argv[3].strip() else "users_difference_report.csv"

def resolve(p):
    quote_chars = chr(34) + chr(39)
    p = p.strip(quote_chars)
    if not p:
        return ""
    if os.path.exists(p):
        return p
    candidate = f"snapshots/users_snapshot_{p}.json"
    if os.path.exists(candidate):
        return candidate
    return p

s1, s2 = resolve(s1), resolve(s2)

if not s1 or not os.path.isfile(s1):
    print(json.dumps({"error": f"First snapshot file not found: {s1}", "status": "failed"}))
    sys.exit(1)

if not s2 or not os.path.isfile(s2):
    print(json.dumps({"error": f"Second snapshot file not found: {s2}", "status": "failed"}))
    sys.exit(1)

u1 = {u["id"]: u for u in json.load(open(s1))} if os.path.exists(s1) else {}
u2 = {u["id"]: u for u in json.load(open(s2))} if os.path.exists(s2) else {}

rows = []
for uid, u in u1.items():
    if uid not in u2:
        rows.append(["DELETED", uid, u.get("profile",{}).get("firstName",""), u.get("profile",{}).get("lastName",""), u.get("profile",{}).get("email",""), u.get("profile",{}).get("login",""), u.get("status",""), "Removed"])

for uid, u in u2.items():
    if uid not in u1:
        rows.append(["ADDED", uid, u.get("profile",{}).get("firstName",""), u.get("profile",{}).get("lastName",""), u.get("profile",{}).get("email",""), u.get("profile",{}).get("login",""), u.get("status",""), "Added"])

for uid, u in u1.items():
    if uid in u2:
        p1, p2 = u.get("profile",{}), u2[uid].get("profile",{})
        diffs = [f"{k}: {p1.get(k)} -> {p2.get(k)}" for k in set(p1)|set(p2) if p1.get(k) != p2.get(k)]
        if diffs:
            rows.append(["MODIFIED", uid, p2.get("firstName",""), p2.get("lastName",""), p2.get("email",""), p2.get("login",""), u2[uid].get("status",""), "; ".join(diffs)])

out_path = out if out.endswith((".csv", ".xlsx")) else f"{out}.csv"
with open(out_path, "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["Change Type", "User ID", "First Name", "Last Name", "Email", "Login", "Status", "Details"])
    w.writerows(rows)

all_files_str = f"{s1}, {s2}, {out_path}"
del_count = sum(1 for r in rows if r[0] == "DELETED")
add_count = sum(1 for r in rows if r[0] == "ADDED")
mod_count = sum(1 for r in rows if r[0] == "MODIFIED")

print(f"Diff report generated: {out_path}")
print(f"Compared: {s1} vs {s2}")
print(f"Deleted users: {del_count}")
print(f"Added users: {add_count}")
print(f"Modified users: {mod_count}")
print(f"Total differences: {len(rows)}")

print(json.dumps({
    "status": "success",
    "excel_file": out_path,
    "diff_file": out_path,
    "report_file": out_path,
    "snapshot1": s1,
    "snapshot2": s2,
    "all_files": all_files_str,
    "files_to_zip": all_files_str,
    "compared_files": all_files_str,
    "deleted_count": del_count,
    "added_count": add_count,
    "modified_count": mod_count,
    "total_changes": len(rows)
}))
' "${answer1}" "${answer2}" "${answer3}"
